componentSet.finding: Source receipt, field map, field census, and both 19-page rendered manifests agree on all nine components.

sourceAndDecisionReceipts.finding: All nine mounted source bytes were independently rehashed and matched receipt SHA-256 and byte length; preflight bound 9/9. No open legal input is recorded.

participantInstructions.finding: The only participant guidance is a required-before-filing fact list and protected-field warning; it supplies no filing sequence, timing/deadline guidance, fee/waiver procedure, service/notice procedure, filing destination, or explicit self-help stop.

filingInstructions.finding: No filing-and-timing guidance deliverable or step-by-step filing procedure exists.

feeAndWaiverTreatment.finding: Instructions merely require a BCI payment or fee-waiver election; they do not explain the fee, waiver path, submission, or court-fee treatment.

serviceAndNotice.finding: Instructions identify facts to complete after service but do not state who must receive service/notice, when, or how.

destination.finding: Instructions request a court address but do not direct the participant where to submit the BCI application or court packet.

deadlineAndTiming.finding: No filing, response, service, or order timing guidance is stated.

selfHelpStop.finding: No explicit boundary states when the participant must stop and seek court clerk, self-help center, or licensed-attorney assistance.

requiredBeforeFilingFacts.finding: Ten missing facts/acts are expressly listed before filing.

repeatingRows.finding: Independent completeness verifier reports incompleteRows=0 for this family.

protectedFields.finding: Independent completeness verifier reports protectedWrites=0; signatures, service certifications, and actor-restricted fields remain reserved.

laterCompletionFields.finding: Service method/address/date/certification and other event-dependent fields are explicitly reserved for later completion.

proposedOrders.finding: Official proposed order 1020EX is present, and court-only completion fields remain protected.

rows.decisiveFailure: The packet component set omits usable filing-and-timing guidance; participant-instructions.md is only a data-completion checklist.
